sources.title: Cross-lingual QA: A Key to Unlocking In-context Cross-lingual Performance
sources.snippet: We compare the average F1 performance for the XQuAD task across model size variants. As shown in Figure 2, cross-lingual transferability increases with model size. We observe that Cross-lingual QA prompting becomes more effective at the 7B scale, with consistent increases on average from 1B to 7B, following the scaling law (Kaplan et al., 2020).

sources.snippet: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated high proficiency on English-centric medical examinations, their performance often declines when faced with non-English languages and multimodal diagnostic tasks.
